wire.headline: Energy Giant Cuts 850 Jobs as Profits Slump
sentences: Revenue rose 7% year over year to 4.26bn GBP in the quarter ending 30 September.
Pre-tax profit declined by 12% to reach 310m GBP.
The company announced 850 job cuts, representing about 6% of its workforce.
Two gas plants, one in Wales and one in Kent, are set to close by March 2027.
CEO Marian Holt stated that cost pressure was sharper than expected.
Ofgem has opened an investigation into the company's billing system.
The dividend was held at 12.4p a share.

PD.headline: Kestrel Securities Cuts 850 Jobs Amid Cost Pressures

sentences.text: In the quarter ending 30 September, revenue increased by 7% year over year to reach 4.26bn GBP.
The workforce will see 850 job cuts, representing about 6% of the total employees.
CEO Marian Holt stated that the cost pressure is sharper than expected.
A Kestrel Securities analyst noted that the job cuts save 90m GBP a year.
Unite intends to ballot members on industrial action.
The MP for Deeside has asked for an urgent meeting with the company.
The company confirmed that customer bills remain unchanged until April 2027.

ND.headline: Energy firm faces 850 job cuts as pre-tax profit drops 12%

sentences.text: The company reported a pre-tax profit of 310m GBP, representing a 12% decrease.
Plans include 850 job cuts, which accounts for about 6% of the workforce.
A Kestrel Securities analyst noted that the job cuts will save 90m GBP a year.
The union Unite intends to ballot its members on industrial action.
The Kent plant employs 410 staff, leaving the local supply chain exposed.
The MP for Deeside has asked for an urgent meeting with the company.
Since 2024, 1,200 staff have left under a voluntary scheme.
Ofgem is scheduled to report preliminary findings by the end of 2026.
Shares closed at 268p, a decline of 11p.
A customer group logged 3,400 billing complaints in six months.
Talks with unions are set to start on 4 November.
In 2023, Ofgem fined the company 1.8m GBP over billing issues.
The company stated there will be no compulsory redundancies before January 2027.
Kestrel Securities cut its price target to 240p from 290p.
This report was published by the Western Mail.
